notes.subject: ⟨i⟩
notes.rationale: Hebrew verb תולד is second person already; gloss keeps it, bracket marks the explicit pronoun Bambara needs for the sarcasm

notes.subject: sabu
notes.rationale: כי read as sarcastic affirmation ('surely you know') vs interrogative ('do you know?'); Bambara 'sabu' follows the affirmative reading

notes.subject: to Iyov
notes.rationale: Yawe's rhetorical question mocks Iyov directly in second person

translation: I dɔn <a>, sabu waati o tɔ ⟨i⟩ bora, ani i ka donw jate ka bon!
